description: Get the public profile of one provider (a dealer, auction house, marketplace or auction platform) by its listingSourceSlugId, the last segment of an Aura Historia provider page URL (/shops/{slug}): name, operator, website and image. Each result's `viewUrl` is the provider link meant to be shared with people: it carries Aura Historia's referral tagging, which is lost when its query parameters are changed. `url` is the provider's untagged address.

listingSourceSlugId.description: Slug ID of the provider, the last segment of an Aura Historia provider page URL.

name: getPublicListingSourceBySlug

PublicListingSourceOperatorData.description: The Party that operates a ListingSource, as shown wherever a source is presented publicly.

partner.description:
`true` while the operator Party has an active Aura Historia Partnership, otherwise
`false`, including after a Partnership is dissolved. Unrelated to ingestion methods and
referral configuration.

url.description: The provider's own address, without Aura Historia's referral tagging; `viewUrl` is the link meant to be shared.

viewUrl.description: Link to the provider's page that is meant to be shared with people. It carries Aura Historia's referral tagging, which is lost when its query parameters are changed.

title: Get listing source
